privacy_presets.preset_applies_whole_privacy_policy: A preset applies a whole privacy policy in one step — LGPD, GDPR, both, or your company's own — through the same ranges and the same notices as each setting on its own. It says how data is kept, never whether it is collected: the contact requests, the agent and its summaries stay as you set them. It is a shortcut and a proof, not compliance: the checklist lists what is left to you. Nothing records who applied a preset, nor when.
privacy_presets.detach_preset_settings_stay_they: Detach the preset? The settings stay as they are; this server becomes Custom.
privacy_presets.no_preset_install_defaults_custom: No preset (install defaults, or Custom). Preview one below to apply it.
privacy_presets.what_emissario_cannot_do_you: What Emissario cannot do for you under this preset. It is a reminder: Emissario keeps no status for these items, done or not; keep your evidence in your own documents.
privacy_presets.saving_under_name_already_used: Saving under a name already used stores its next version: a version never changes. The checklist is copied from the preset applied; add your own items and references in an export, then import it.
privacy_presets.checked_against_format_ranges_known: Checked against the format, the ranges and the known drafts, then stored — not applied. A preset with a setting missing, out of range or unknown is refused.

privacy_settings.how_this_server_keeps_personal: How this server keeps personal data, under the LGPD, the Marco Civil da Internet and the GDPR. You — the operator of this website — are the controller (LGPD art. 5 VI; GDPR art. 4(7)): Emissario helps you comply and cannot comply for you. The notices are product information, not legal advice. Nothing here records who changed a setting, nor that a notice was read.
privacy_settings.preset_applies_whole_policy_lgpd: A preset applies a whole policy — LGPD, GDPR, both, or your company's own — in one step, and shows when this server drifts from it.
privacy_settings.key_comes_from_emissario_encrypt: The key comes from EMISSARIO_ENCRYPT_KEY: losing it loses every database and every backup. It protects a stolen disk or backup, not a running server.
privacy_settings.what_records_keep_ip: What the records keep of an IP
privacy_settings.views_contact_requests_agent_usage: Views, contact requests and agent usage. Hashed: an HMAC under a random key kept here — it counts visitors and matches an abuser, and cannot be reversed without the key. It is still personal data (pseudonymous). Full asks for a notice. A change applies to new rows.
privacy_settings.what_viewers_see_full_ip: What viewers see of a full IP
privacy_settings.keep_ips_records_days: Keep the IPs of the records (days)
privacy_settings.hashed_full_ip_older_than: Hashed or full, an IP older than this is blanked every hour; its record stays until its own retention ends. 184 by default; past 365, or blank, asks for a notice.
privacy_settings.keep_access_log_every_page: Keep the access log: every page view and public API call, with the full IP, the source port and the time in UTC
privacy_settings.off_default_turning_asks_notice: Off by default. Turning it on asks for a notice. Turning it off stops new rows; the rows kept stay until their retention ends.
privacy_settings.brazil_if_this_website_run: Brazil: if this website is run by a company for profit, Marco Civil art. 15 requires access logs (IP, source port, date and time) kept 6 months. Turn on the access log, or keep your reverse proxy's logs for 6 months under the same rules (Decreto 8.771/2016 art. 13).
privacy_settings.access_log_has_no_source: The access log has no source port: behind a reverse proxy, set --client-port-header (nginx: proxy_set_header X-Client-Port $remote_port;).
privacy_settings.184_default_longest_6_month: 184 by default, the longest 6-month span; below 184 (Brazil) or past 365 (EU), or blank, asks for a notice. A row on a legal hold is kept until the hold ends.
privacy_settings.readers_sign_with_two_factor: Its readers sign in with two-factor (Decreto 8.771/2016 art. 13 II)
privacy_settings.keep_inventory_every_read_art: Keep an inventory of every read of it (art. 13 III)
privacy_settings.both_default_turning_one_off: Both on by default; turning one off asks for a notice.
privacy_settings.data_retention_deletes_lives_snapshots: Data a retention deletes lives on in the snapshots taken before. Blank — the default — or longer than the longest retention of the records asks for a notice.
privacy_settings.only_roots_ticked_here_read: Only the roots ticked here read the access log (Decreto 8.771/2016 art. 13 I)
privacy_settings.only_after_two_factor_sign: , and only after a two-factor sign-in
privacy_settings.base_your_records_processing_lgpd: The base of your records of processing (LGPD art. 37; GDPR art. 30). The legal basis is a suggestion: you choose it, and document it in your own records.
privacy_settings.draft_review_built_from_settings: Draft — review it. Built from the settings in use: what is kept, why, for how long, the access log, the model provider, that no cookie is set and the chat history stays in the visitor's browser, the rights and the time to answer them. Fill in the [brackets] — the controller, the contact, the encarregado or DPO — and publish it on your website. Its template is set above.
privacy_settings.rows_kept_past_their_retention: Rows kept past their retention and out of Find and erase, for an authority's request (Marco Civil art. 15 §2) or a lawsuit. Hold rows from a contact request, a summary or the access log. A preservation request is confidential (Marco Civil art. 13 §4).
privacy_settings.release_this_hold_rows_follow: Release this hold? Its rows follow their retention again, and the cleanup may delete them at once.
privacy_settings.notices_settings_use: Notices of the settings in use
privacy_settings.no_setting_use_needs_notice: No setting in use needs a notice: this server runs with the private defaults.
privacy_settings.turn_every_full_ip_views: Turn every full IP the views, contact requests and agent usage keep into its hash, and blank the full user agents? This cannot be undone. The access log keeps its full IPs.
privacy_settings.every_full_ip_records_becomes: Every full IP of the records becomes its hash under the current IP key. The access log is kept as it is.
privacy_settings.rotate_ip_key_hashes_made: Rotate the IP key? The hashes made before stop matching new visits and any IP you type. This cannot be undone.
privacy_settings.new_random_key_hashes_kept: A new random key: the hashes kept can no longer be matched to new visits nor confirmed against an IP — the way to forget the linkage early, after a server compromise for one.

privacy_subject.answer_persons_access_erasure_requests: Answer a person's access and erasure requests (LGPD arts. 18–19, a full answer within 15 days; GDPR arts. 15 and 17, within one month). Look for an IP — hashed with the current IP key to match the hashes — or a text they sent: an email, a phone, a name. Export JSON answers an access or portability request; Delete all an erasure request. Nothing records who looked or erased.
privacy_subject.hashes_made_before_ip_key: Hashes made before the IP key of {0} no longer match any IP (GDPR art. 11: no duty to re-identify).
privacy_subject.access_log_searched_only_readers: The access log is searched only for its readers, and by IP.
privacy_subject.every_record_above_json_what: Every record above, as JSON: what an access or a portability request asks for (LGPD art. 18 II, V; GDPR arts. 15, 20).
privacy_subject.delete_every_record_this_person: Delete every record of this person but the ones marked kept? This cannot be undone.
privacy_subject.deletes_records_kept_access_log: Deletes {0} records. Kept: the access log rows, kept to meet a legal obligation (LGPD art. 16 I; GDPR art. 17(3)(b)), and the rows on a legal hold, until it is released. Snapshots taken before keep the deleted rows until the backup retention removes them; a restore deletes them again.
privacy_subject.also_delete_access_log_rows: Also delete the access log rows — a for-profit company in Brazil must keep them 6 months; held rows are never deleted
privacy_subject.read_before_you_confirm_this: Read before you confirm. This notice is product information, not legal advice: you are the controller of this data.
